question: What must an applicant provide to evidence a common-law union?

claims.text: The applicant must submit a Statutory Declaration of Common-Law Union form (IMM 5409) and evidence of cohabitation for a period of at least 12 continuous months.
claims.quote: The applicant must submit a Statutory Declaration of Common-Law Union form [[IMM 5409 (PDF, 636.51 KB)](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/pdf/kits/forms/imm5409e.pdf)] and evidence of cohabitation for a period of at least 12 continuous months.

basis: The attached statutory declaration document for case ID fe518795975250588461a0cff81741f1 submitted under upload slot statutory_declaration_common_law was reviewed against Express Entry completeness criteria.
Solemnization check: Form IMM 5409 is fully executed with deponent signatures, commissioner/notary signature, official stamp, and declaration date.
Cohabitation duration check: Continuous cohabitation is evidenced for 25 months, satisfying the minimum requirement of at least 12 continuous months.
Financial interdependence check: Section 2 and supporting evidence demonstrate joint financial arrangements, including joint bank account statements, shared lease, and utility bills.
Cross-form consistency check: Cohabitation dates, residential address, and marital status are consistent across IMM 5409, Express Entry history, CRA filings, and identity documentation.
Overall verdict: No defects found; the submission satisfies all completeness requirements for a statutory declaration of common-law union.
